assigned-principal-id.description: Target principal identifier reported in a role assignment request or response.

assigned-principal-type.description: Target principal type reported in a role assignment request or response.

assigned-role-assignment-id.description: Target role assignment identifier reported in a role assignment request or response.

assigned-role-definition-id.description: Target role definition reported in a role assignment request or response.

assignment-scope.description: Target scope reported in a role assignment request or response.

assignment-source.description: Source body from which the target role assignment values were extracted.

authorization-action.description: Action reported in the event's actor authorization context.

authorization-principal-id.description: Principal identifier reported in the actor authorization evidence.

authorization-principal-type.description: Principal type reported in the actor authorization evidence.

authorization-role.description: Role reported in the actor authorization context.

authorization-role-assignment-id.description: Role assignment identifier reported as actor authorization evidence.

authorization-role-assignment-scope.description: Scope of the role assignment reported as actor authorization evidence.

authorization-role-definition-id.description: Role definition identifier reported as actor authorization evidence.

authorization-scope.description: Scope covered by the actor authorization context.

caller.description: Reported caller or caller identifier selected from available identity claims.

caller-address.description: Original caller address reported for the operation.

caller-application-id.description: Application identifier in the caller's identity claims.

caller-object-id.description: Object identifier in the caller's identity claims.

caller-source.description: Source field used for the caller value.

caller-tenant-id.description: Directory tenant identifier in the caller's identity claims.

client-request-id.description: Client request ID as reported by the HTTP request context.

correlation-id.description: Azure correlation ID for potentially related events.

diagnostic-category.description: Native Azure Monitor diagnostic category field.

event-id.description: Native EventDataId of this Activity Log event, where supplied.

event-name.description: Source event name, such as BeginRequest or EndRequest.

event-record-id.description: Resource Manager record identifier for this Activity Log event.

event-time.description: Event time normalized to UTC at microsecond precision.

event-time-raw.description: Original event timestamp, including its full precision and offset.

operation.description: Reported Azure operation name for this event.

operation-id.description: Reported operation ID, which may group several events.

operation-source.description: Source of the operation when derived from the reported authorization action.

resource-group.description: Azure resource group reported for this event.

resource-id.description: Reported identifier of the Azure resource associated with this event.

resource-provider.description: Azure resource provider reported for this event.

resource-type.description: Azure resource type reported for this event.

result.description: Operation status or result reported by Azure.

source-ip.description: Validated IP address from the caller address field.

source-schema.description: Azure Activity Log schema used by the source export.

status-code.description: Code or label reported in the operation's statusCode property.

submission-time.description: Azure Activity Log submission timestamp normalized to UTC.

submission-time-raw.description: Original Azure Activity Log submission timestamp.

subscription-id.description: Reported subscription identifier or subscription in the resource ID.

tenant-id.description: Directory tenant identifier reported on the event.

workspace-id.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier from the AzureActivity TenantId column.

description: A reported Azure Resource Manager Activity Log event with operation, actor, resource, result and source provenance.
name: azure-activity-log-event
